pr_title: Fix sending an empty String like "" causes an error #9429
pr_body:
Motivation:

Handle https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7692#section-7.2.3.6

Result:

The empty buffer is correctly handled in deflate  encoder/decoder. Fixes #9429 .
pr_comments: Can one of the admins verify this patch?
